transcript.text: Good evening, everyone. Let's get our standard roundtable started for The Last Orchard presentation plan. Before we move toward final approval, I need to ask our rights and music leads to report any confirmed changes to the plan. Are there any updates or issues we should know about?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue. I reviewed the revised license email from the Orchard Estate this morning. The license permits exactly one public screening, requires 35mm projection, prohibits any audience or house recording, and requires the credit line 'Courtesy of Orchard Estate.' I have not yet uploaded this email to the shared production packet. This directly conflicts with several elements of our draft plan — we have two public screenings planned, a digital cinema package, audience photography, and a standard courtesy credit that doesn't match the required wording.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to report a confirmed change on the music side. I received the signed musicians' agreement after the rehearsal plan was circulated. It requires a 14-player ensemble, and the conductor has approved only a 4:30 PM to 5:30 PM rehearsal on October 18. I have not yet added the agreement to the shared call sheet. This conflicts with our draft plan, which calls for a 10-player ensemble and a 3:00 PM to 4:00 PM rehearsal.
transcript.speaker: A3
